name: Hiap Teck Venture Berhad
overview: 2026年，Hiap Teck Venture Berhad 未在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约。公司发布了2026年年报并召开股东大会，同时宣派每股0.7仙的首次及末期单层股息。最新季度营收同比下降28.1%，净利润同比上升2.3%。
overview_en: In 2026, Hiap Teck Venture Berhad did not disclose any expansion, reduction, disposal, or new contracts for its business segments in its announcements. The company released its 2026 annual report and held a general meeting, while declaring a first and final single-tier dividend of 0.7 sen per share. Latest quarterly revenue declined 28.1% year-on-year, while net profit rose 2.3% year-on-year.
